data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 10.1m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2016: GBP 2.6m) arising predominantly from the nuclear property class (2016: predominantly from the nuclear liability class).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross release of prior year reserves of GBP 10.1m in 2017, driven predominantly by favourable development in its nuclear property business. This release reduced gross claims outstanding compared with the opening reserve position and was the primary contributor to the reduction in net incurred claims for the year.
